messages.subject: Jake Essex for Churchills Club Eastleigh?
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm Natalie — I look after bookings for Jake Essex.

Churchills already runs Saturday night entertainment from half eight to eleven, and September's diary is live with Pure Cheese Disco, Diamond & Bowie and Ivan J still to come.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist from Essex. High-energy 50s and 60s rock and roll. He is the act — no tribute, no jumpsuit. Own PA, fully self-contained, no deposit.

Have a look: www.jakeessex.co.uk

Friday nights, Saturdays, Sundays and functions this year and into 2027 — if a date works, reply here and I'll lock it.

Best regards,
Natalie
